section: 40.4 Constant-probability regimes and their countable models (duty MP-0)
placement_note: Chapter 40 sections 40.1-40.3 (packets w03a-p03-064..066) should precede this file once they exist; the body opens with \chapter per the packet heading level.

duties.written: Constant regimes (G(n,p): schema, witness bound, game completeness, zero-one law, p-independence; SU(n,p) unary theorem) with full annex proofs; almost-sure-theory statement; countable-model classification: aleph_0-categoricity of both constant theories with identification (Rado graph; two infinite classes); sparse failure theorem; irrational-alpha non-categoricity with full proofs: arithmetic lemma, circulant rigid one-root extensions with glued H^s safe and almost surely present, compactness model with infinite closure, witness-demand construction with Nonexistence, Generic Extension, t-genericity and finite closures, uniqueness of the witness-demand graph, non-isomorphism; worked examples (K4 bound; K5 versus H(13) at pi/7), warning, relationships, sources; block 2: the step that the witness-demand graph is a model of T_alpha is reduced to proved handbook results by thm:p03-w03-p03-067-axioms-generate (body 323-376, annex 279-372): the 068 Nonexistence and Generic Extension axioms are shown equivalent, datum by datum in every graph, to the axioms of def:p03-w03-p03-070-theory; with thm:p03-w03-p03-070-as-holds (proved from thm:p03-w03-p03-064-theory-as) and thm:p03-w03-p03-070-complete item 2 this gives that every 068 axiom holds almost surely, that the almost sure theory T_alpha is exactly the set of logical consequences of graph axioms plus the 068 axioms, consistent and complete, and that its models are the graphs satisfying the 068 axioms. Item 4 of thm:p03-w03-p03-067-demand-model (annex 621-630) and thm:p03-w03-p03-067-sparse-models now use this lemma instead of the cited thm:p03-w03-p03-068-axiomatized.
